c4Details.responsibility: Configure web request interceptors for multi-tenancy header processing in Spring MVC application
interactions: Registers HeaderTenantInterceptor with Spring MVC interceptor registry
Integrates tenant identification from HTTP headers into request processing pipeline
componentRelationships: Depends on HeaderTenantInterceptor for tenant extraction
Integrates with Spring WebMvcConfigurer for configuration

infrastructure.scalingNeeds: Stateless configuration suitable for horizontal scaling

security.authenticationNeeds: HTTP header validation for tenant context

criticalOperations: Header tenant extraction on each request

attributes.name: headerTenantInterceptor
attributes.description: Interceptor instance for extracting tenant information from request headers

methods.name: WebConfiguration
methods.description: Constructor for dependency injection of HeaderTenantInterceptor

methods.name: addInterceptors
methods.description: Register web request interceptors with Spring MVC

relationships.description: Injected dependency for tenant header processing

flows.name: Interceptor Registration Flow
steps: Spring instantiates WebConfiguration with HeaderTenantInterceptor dependency
Spring calls addInterceptors method during MVC configuration
Interceptor becomes active in request processing pipeline

flows.name: Request Processing Flow
steps: Tenant information extracted from request headers
Tenant context established for request processing

mainScenarios.name: Multi-Tenant Request Routing
preconditions: HTTP request contains tenant identifier in headers
steps: Client sends HTTP request with tenant header
Interceptor extracts tenant ID from request header
Tenant context is set for request scope
Request is routed to appropriate tenant database
postconditions: Request processed in correct tenant context
businessRules: Each request must be associated with a valid tenant
Tenant information must be extracted from HTTP headers
Tenant context must be available throughout request lifecycle
